en.hero_subtitle: Calm, shy, gentle and smart girl. Likes sniffy walks and lot of cuddles. Used to appartment living.
en.quote_text: The hardest part of her life is over. The best part is still waiting. Would you like to be in it?
en.story_heading: She found safety. Now she's looking for home.
en.story_p1: Srna spent the first part of her life without the comfort and security every dog deserves. Eventually, she found herself in a municipal shelter, where her chances of finding the kind of life she deserved were uncertain.
en.story_p2: Then she got a second chance. Today, Srna lives in a foster home, where she has discovered some of life's greatest luxuries: soft couches, long naps, leisurely walks, toys of her own, and humans who are always available for cuddles. She's learned what it feels like to be safe, loved, and part of a home.
en.story_p3: But fostering was never meant to be the end of her story. Somewhere out there is the person who will choose her for good — who will give her a couch that is truly hers, a routine she can count on, and a home she'll never have to leave. Until then, she gets to stay safe with us and wait for them to find her.
en.details_heading: What to expect day to day.
en.trait_1_body: No accidents in foster care. She asks to go out and waits at the door.
en.trait_2_body: No resource guarding, no rough play. Calm around kids and other pets.
en.trait_3_body: Doesn't pull. Happy with two walks a day, plus yard time if available.
en.trait_4_body: Can be left alone for a work day. Naps, doesn't destroy things.
en.looking_heading: A patient family, first and foremost.
en.looking_1_body: She needs time to settle. No returns policy — just a bit of grace.
en.looking_2_title: A fenced yard or regular walks
en.looking_2_body: She doesn't need a farm, just consistent time outside.
en.looking_3_body: Indoor family life only — that's the whole point of this move.
en.contact_body: Belgrade — short visit, no pressure to decide on the spot.
en.share_body: Every repost puts her in front of someone who might be looking.

sr.hero_subtitle: Mirna, nežna devojčica, trenutno udomljena u Beogradu. Traži svoju porodicu.
sr.quote_text: Svako veče je čekala kraj ograde skloništa, kao da će je neko ipak doći po nju. Niko nije došao — pa smo mi.
sr.story_heading: Mirna devojčica kojoj treba samo rutina.
sr.story_p1: Srna je prvu godinu provela na lancu ispred seoske kuće, pre nego što je predata lokalnom skloništu. Isprva je oprezna sa novim ljudima, ali se brzo otvori kada stekne poverenje — i onda vas ne ispušta iz vida.
sr.story_p2: U udomiteljstvu je naučila šta je kauč, kako izgleda šetnja na povocu i da zvono na vratima nije pretnja. Motivisana je hranom, lako se dresira i najbolje funkcioniše uz predvidljivu dnevnu rutinu.
sr.story_p3: Ne traži mnogo. Samo vrata koja ostaju otvorena.
sr.details_heading: Šta očekivati iz dana u dan.
sr.trait_1_body: Bez nezgoda u udomiteljstvu. Traži da izađe napolje i čeka kod vrata.
sr.trait_2_body: Ne čuva hranu ni igračke, ne igra se grubo. Mirna sa decom i drugim ljubimcima.
sr.trait_3_body: Ne vuče. Zadovoljna je sa dve šetnje dnevno, plus vreme u dvorištu ako postoji.
sr.trait_4_body: Može ostati sama tokom radnog dana. Spava, ne uništava stvari.
sr.looking_1_body: Treba joj vreme da se navikne. Nema vraćanja — samo malo strpljenja.
sr.looking_2_body: Ne treba joj imanje, samo redovno vreme napolju.
sr.looking_3_body: Samo život u porodici, u kući — to je i cela poenta ove promene.
sr.contact_body: Beograd — kratka poseta, bez pritiska da se odlučite odmah.
sr.share_body: Svako deljenje je šansa da je vidi neko ko možda traži baš nju.
